statement:
∀ (n : ℕ),
  1 ≤ n →
    1 / (2 * ↑n + 1) < ↑(harmonic n) - log ↑n - eulerMascheroniConstant ∧
      ↑(harmonic n) - log ↑n - eulerMascheroniConstant < 1 / (2 * ↑n)
